newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $41.45 million of T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $41.45 million of T-bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold all 850 million rupees ($41.45 million) of T-bills tendered for sale at its weekly auction, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 195.7 million rupees of 91-day bills at a weighted average yield of 10.24 percent at auction, against 135.0 million rupees at 10.28 percent last week.
The bank sold 141.0 million rupees of 182-day bills with an average yield of 10.58 percent, against 171.2 million rupees at 10.60 percent last week.
It sold 513.3 million rupees of 364-day bills at an average yield of 10.56 percent, against 293.8 million rupees at 10.58 percent.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.49 percent per annum from 10.52 percent last week, the bank said.
